The like operation is now documented, so I will like every one of the eight target transactions and retain each response for verification.

```python
like_results = []
for transaction_id in target_transaction_ids:
    result = apis.venmo.like_transaction(
        transaction_id=transaction_id,
        access_token=venmo_access_token
    )
    like_results.append({'transaction_id': transaction_id, 'result': result})
print(like_results)
```
